--- text
alpha beta gamma
$$
xy
$$
delta epsi|lon zeta
--- keys
Up Up Up Up
--- expect
alpha beta| gamma
$$
xy
$$
delta epsilon zeta
--- note
The goal column must survive an UPWARD crossing of a rendered `$$` block, the
same invariant fixtures 05/06/22/23 assert across short and empty lines, now
across display math instead. The caret starts at column 10 of the bottom prose
line ("delta epsi|lon zeta").

Up #1 is claimed by mdEnterDisplayMathFromBelow (md-math-plugin.ts): the caret
sits on the line directly below the block, so it lands column-preserving on the
closing `$$` line via dispatchVerticalStop, which CAPTURES the goal x (column
10) into the vertical-motion session (callout-core.ts). "$$" is two characters,
so sameColumnOnLine clamps the landing to column 2, but the session keeps the
column-10 x alive.

Ups #2-#4 are mdVerticalArrowKeymap presses. Each reads verticalGoalX from the
live session (still column 10), so the landings on "xy" and "$$" clamp to column
2 without consuming the goal. The final Up reaches the top prose line "alpha
beta gamma", which is long enough to hold column 10, so the caret must land
after "alpha beta" (offset 10). Landing at column 2 there would be the
"Down doesn't go where I aimed" decay bug that md-vertical-motion.ts exists to
prevent. The upward direction is chosen because the edit-mode preview widget
renders below the block, so it never sits in the upward path; the whole crossing
is a clean line-by-line reveal.
